en: The front side of the postcard shows a monochrome photograph of a fortress situated on rocky shoreline with waves crashing against it. The building complex includes several pitched-roof structures and a lamp post near the edge. The text 'Varbergs Fästning' appears in the lower-right corner. The reverse side has handwritten text in Swedish, a red Swedish postage stamp, and postal marks.
